label: plan-to-pipeline:cohort-comparison-by-pedal-count
text:
Analytical plan for cohort_comparison with control_strategy=outlier_filter_v1: Compare loss frequency, lifetime value, and retention across one-pedal, two-pedal, and three-pedal cohorts, controlling for age/zip/mileage as outlier filters (NOT stratified buckets). Filter to valid documents (pedal_count in [1,2,3], annual_mileage >= 1000, age >= 18). Derive claim_count from loss_history array length and loss_to_premium_ratio. Group directly by vehicle.pedal_count (no stratification, no rollup) and compute count, avg_claim_count, total_claims, avg_mileage, avg_age, avg_lifetime_value, avg_retention_probability, avg_tenure_months, avg_loss_to_premium_ratio, total_premiums, total_claims_paid, avg_cross_sell_count. Derive per-group: loss_frequency_per_1000, overall_loss_ratio, pedal_label. Project clean output with renamed fields. Sort by pedal_count ascending.

MongoDB aggregation pipeline:
[
  {"$match": {"vehicle.pedal_count": {"$in": [1, 2, 3]}, "vehicle.annual_mileage": {"$gte": 1000}, "customer.age": {"$gte": 18}}},
  {"$addFields": {"claim_count": {"$size": {"$ifNull": ["$loss_history", []]}}, "loss_to_premium_ratio": {"$cond": {"if": {"$gt": ["$ltv.total_premiums_paid", 0]}, "then": {"$divide": ["$ltv.total_claims_paid", "$ltv.total_premiums_paid"]}, "else": null}}}},
  {"$group": {"_id": "$vehicle.pedal_count", "count": {"$sum": 1}, "avg_claim_count": {"$avg": "$claim_count"}, "total_claims": {"$sum": "$claim_count"}, "avg_mileage": {"$avg": "$vehicle.annual_mileage"}, "avg_age": {"$avg": "$customer.age"}, "avg_lifetime_value": {"$avg": "$ltv.estimated_lifetime_value"}, "avg_retention_probability": {"$avg": "$ltv.retention_probability"}, "avg_tenure_months": {"$avg": "$ltv.tenure_months"}, "avg_loss_to_premium_ratio": {"$avg": "$loss_to_premium_ratio"}, "total_premiums": {"$sum": "$ltv.total_premiums_paid"}, "total_claims_paid": {"$sum": "$ltv.total_claims_paid"}, "avg_cross_sell_count": {"$avg": {"$size": {"$ifNull": ["$ltv.cross_sell_products", []]}}}}},
  {"$addFields": {"loss_frequency_per_1000": {"$round": [{"$multiply": [{"$divide": ["$total_claims", "$count"]}, 1000]}, 1]}, "overall_loss_ratio": {"$round": [{"$divide": ["$total_claims_paid", "$total_premiums"]}, 4]}, "pedal_label": {"$switch": {"branches": [{"case": {"$eq": ["$_id", 1]}, "then": "One-pedal (EV)"}, {"case": {"$eq": ["$_id", 2]}, "then": "Two-pedal (automatic)"}, {"case": {"$eq": ["$_id", 3]}, "then": "Three-pedal (manual)"}], "default": "Unknown"}}}},
  {"$project": {"_id": 0, "pedal_count": "$_id", "pedal_label": 1, "sample_size": "$count", "loss_frequency_per_1000": 1, "total_claims": 1, "avg_claim_count": {"$round": ["$avg_claim_count", 3]}, "avg_mileage": {"$round": ["$avg_mileage", 0]}, "avg_age": {"$round": ["$avg_age", 1]}, "avg_lifetime_value": 1, "avg_retention_probability": {"$round": ["$avg_retention_probability", 2]}, "avg_tenure_years": {"$round": [{"$divide": ["$avg_tenure_months", 12]}, 1]}, "overall_loss_ratio": 1, "avg_loss_to_premium_ratio": {"$round": ["$avg_loss_to_premium_ratio", 4]}, "avg_cross_sell_count": {"$round": ["$avg_cross_sell_count", 2]}}},
  {"$sort": {"pedal_count": 1}}
]

label: plan-to-pipeline:trend-by-pedal-count-and-quarter
text:
Analytical plan for trend_over_time with control_strategy=outlier_filter_v1: Show how quarterly loss frequency has changed over time for each pedal count group. This is a claim-frequency trend, not a cohort-mix trend. Filter to valid documents. Unwind loss_history using the valid object form with only `path` and `preserveNullAndEmptyArrays`. Compute quarter bucket from loss_history.date as YYYY-QN. Filter out null quarters. Group by pedal_count and quarter, count distinct policies and claims. Derive loss_frequency_per_1000 per quarter. Project clean output. Sort by pedal_count then quarter.

MongoDB aggregation pipeline:
[
  {"$match": {"vehicle.pedal_count": {"$in": [1, 2, 3]}, "vehicle.annual_mileage": {"$gte": 1000}, "customer.age": {"$gte": 18}}},
  {"$unwind": {"path": "$loss_history", "preserveNullAndEmptyArrays": true}},
  {"$addFields": {"claim_quarter": {"$cond": {"if": {"$ifNull": ["$loss_history.date", false]}, "then": {"$concat": [{"$toString": {"$year": {"$toDate": "$loss_history.date"}}}, "-Q", {"$toString": {"$ceil": {"$divide": [{"$month": {"$toDate": "$loss_history.date"}}, 3]}}}]}, "else": null}}}},
  {"$match": {"claim_quarter": {"$ne": null}}},
  {"$group": {"_id": {"pedal_count": "$vehicle.pedal_count", "quarter": "$claim_quarter"}, "policy_ids": {"$addToSet": "$policy_id"}, "claim_count": {"$sum": 1}}},
  {"$addFields": {"cohort_size": {"$size": "$policy_ids"}, "loss_frequency_per_1000": {"$round": [{"$multiply": [{"$divide": ["$claim_count", {"$size": "$policy_ids"}]}, 1000]}, 1]}}},
  {"$project": {"_id": 0, "pedal_count": "$_id.pedal_count", "quarter": "$_id.quarter", "cohort_size": 1, "claim_count": 1, "loss_frequency_per_1000": 1}},
  {"$sort": {"pedal_count": 1, "quarter": 1}}
]

label: plan-to-pipeline:cohort-mix-share-by-quarter
text:
Analytical plan for trend_over_time with control_strategy=outlier_filter_v1: Compute each pedal cohort's share of the in-force book per quarter for the pedal-count demo. Use `book_quarters`, which is already seeded on each Customer document to represent the quarters the policy is in force. Filter to valid documents first. Unwind `book_quarters`. Group by `(vehicle.pedal_count, book_quarters)` to count policies per cohort per quarter. Then compute each cohort's share of that quarter's total policy count. Project flat rows with quarter, pedal_count, policy_count, and share_pct. Sort by quarter then pedal_count. This answers 'how has the cohort mix changed over time' directly from book membership, not claim activity.

MongoDB aggregation pipeline:
[
  {"$match": {"vehicle.pedal_count": {"$in": [1, 2, 3]}, "vehicle.annual_mileage": {"$gte": 1000}, "customer.age": {"$gte": 18}}},
  {"$unwind": "$book_quarters"},
  {"$group": {"_id": {"pedal_count": "$vehicle.pedal_count", "quarter": "$book_quarters"}, "policy_count": {"$sum": 1}}},
  {"$group": {"_id": "$_id.quarter", "quarter_total": {"$sum": "$policy_count"}, "cohorts": {"$push": {"pedal_count": "$_id.pedal_count", "policy_count": "$policy_count"}}}},
  {"$unwind": "$cohorts"},
  {"$project": {"_id": 0, "quarter": "$_id", "pedal_count": "$cohorts.pedal_count", "policy_count": "$cohorts.policy_count", "share_pct": {"$round": [{"$multiply": [{"$divide": ["$cohorts.policy_count", "$quarter_total"]}, 100]}, 1]}}},
  {"$sort": {"quarter": 1, "pedal_count": 1}}
]

label: plan-to-pipeline:simple-count-by-risk-tier
text:
Analytical plan: Count the number of policies in each risk tier and compute the average base rate per tier. Filter to valid documents with pedal_count in [1,2,3]. Group by current_factors.risk_tier. Compute count and average base_rate. Sort by count descending.

MongoDB aggregation pipeline:
[
  {"$match": {"vehicle.pedal_count": {"$in": [1, 2, 3]}}},
  {"$group": {"_id": "$current_factors.risk_tier", "count": {"$sum": 1}, "avg_base_rate": {"$avg": "$current_factors.base_rate"}}},
  {"$project": {"_id": 0, "risk_tier": "$_id", "count": 1, "avg_base_rate": {"$round": ["$avg_base_rate", 0]}}},
  {"$sort": {"count": -1}}
]
